lifecycle.desktop_shortcut_and_wrapper: External invocation and before/after file hashes require the root caller's separate evidence; this reviewer does not inspect host desktop files.

scope: Read-only linkage/count/hash review of already executed gates. No engines, source identity regeneration, PCK pixel decoding, physical input/focus/FPS, earned-progress recovery or leak-proof soak. Per-case preference hashes are contemporaneous receipt claims checked for consistency and against final on-disk bytes; historical per-case files are not snapshots. The checked-runner invocation and source/native teardown gates supply process/ownership evidence beyond the safe-close log marker. The actual desktop shortcut/wrapper invocation and its before/after hashes remain separately supplied root-caller evidence; this reviewer does not claim to verify those external host files.
